#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int go(long long n) {
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    long long k = 1;
    int cnt = 1;
    while (k * 10 + 1 < n) {
        k = k * 10 + 1;
        cnt++;
    }
    return min(go(n % k) + n / k * cnt,
               go((k * 10 + 1 - n) % k) + (cnt + 1) + (k * 10 + 1 - n) / k * cnt);
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << go(n) << endl;
    return 0;
}
